name: windsor-ai-instagram-public
description: Windsor.ai Instagram Public lets marketers benchmark public Instagram Business and Creator profiles, such as competitors, partners, or their own brand, using live data. Users can see which public profiles they track, inspect valid fields, and query follower and following counts, number of posts, and post-level likes, comments, captions, media type, and publish dates over any date range, and connect the connector to start tracking a profile. It covers publicly available profile and post data only: it does not run write actions, post or comment, or access private accounts or private insights such as reach. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to. Instagram is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

positive.prompt: Which public Instagram profiles am I tracking in Windsor.ai?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tracked public Instagram profiles so the user can choose which to analyze.

positive.prompt: Show the valid fields for a report on my tracked public Instagram profiles.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns usable field IDs for profile metrics and post metrics.

positive.prompt: Compare the follower counts and number of posts of the Instagram profiles I track.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns follower count and post count per tracked profile using valid fields.

positive.prompt: Which posts from my tracked Instagram profiles got the most likes and comments in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top posts by likes and comments with captions and links, using valid fields and the requested date range.

positive.description: Help a user start tracking a profile.
positive.prompt: I want to start tracking a public Instagram profile. Give me the setup link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Windsor.ai setup URL for connecting the Instagram Public connector.

negative.description: Do not trigger for private insights of the user's own account.
